title: XCP CAN Configuration
text: Configure XCP server connection; {Config name} sets the xCP CAN session name, {A2L File} selects an A2L file, {Enable seed/key security} selects that key required to establish, {File (*.DLL)} selects file for seed and key security file, {User-defined connect mode} allows special connect mode and {Output connection status} displays connection status. Values come from the instance.

params.name: A2L File
params.values: Select an A2L file file name

params.name: Enable seed/key security
params.values: Select that key required to establish connection off (default) | on

params.name: File (*.DLL)
params.values: Select file for seed and key security file name

params.name: User-defined connect mode
params.values: Allow special connect mode off (default) | on
